reviews.text:
I absolutely love everything from Pyunkang Yul and their ‘Calming Acne Cleansing Foam’ is no different! 

It’s a wonderfully gentle yet effective face wash, especially for acne-prone and sensitive skin. Formulated with calming ingredients like Centella Asiatica and tea tree extract, it helps soothe redness and irritation while cleansing pores without stripping moisture. 

It leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed and comfortable rather than tight or dry. Love it!
reviews.zh:
我非常喜歡 Pyunkang Yul 嘅所有產品，而佢哋嘅「Calming Acne Cleansing Foam」都一樣好。

佢係一款好溫和但有效嘅洗面奶，特別適合易長痘同敏感嘅皮膚。配方加入咗 Centella Asiatica 同茶樹提取物等舒緩成分，有助減輕泛紅同刺激，同時清潔毛孔，又唔會奪走水分。

用完之後，皮膚感覺清潔、清爽、舒適，唔會繃緊或者乾燥。我好鍾意！

reviews.text: I really like this line but this cleanser is nothing special, not bad, but it's pretty standard for a foaming korean cleanser, very gentle though and not drying
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個系列，但呢款潔面產品冇乜特別。唔差，不過都係韓國泡沫潔面產品嘅標準水平，非常溫和，而且唔會太乾。

reviews.text: this is my all time favorite product i really see a difference and benefits after i use it its super hydrating, calming, sothing reduces my acne scars,hyperpigmentation and give me a super glowi skin, i have combination sensitive acne prone skin and its really help me so much with my redness around the nose and the lips,+reduce my pores too so i highly recomend this one for everyone its relly the best product i use so i recomend it for everyone who want more hydrating and have acne scars and hyperpigmentation it will help u a lott i'm suree the best cleanser !its also so good for wrinkles and redness if u have sensitive skinn like my skin its super hydrating and calming i really recomend it to try it
reviews.zh: 呢個係我最愛嘅產品，用完之後我真係見到分別同好處。佢超級補濕、舒緩、安撫，減少咗我嘅痘印同色素沉澱，令我皮膚超級有光澤。我係混合、敏感、易長痘嘅皮膚，佢真係幫咗我好多，改善咗我鼻同唇周圍嘅泛紅，亦收細咗毛孔。所以我極力推薦俾所有人。呢個真係我用過最好嘅產品，所以我推薦俾所有想補濕、有痘印同色素沉澱嘅人，佢會幫到你好多。我相信佢係最好嘅潔面產品！佢對皺紋同泛紅都好有效，如果你皮膚敏感，好似我咁，佢超級補濕、舒緩，我真係好推薦你試吓。

reviews.text: My skin is dry and sensitive so for my second cleanse cleansers I look for a mild, easy-to-foam and bonus if it includes minor exfoliation type. This one checks all my demands perfectly. I usually foam the products, do a one pass on my face and then wash it off so it doesn't stay on my skin for too long. I quite enjoy this one.
reviews.zh: 我皮膚乾性又敏感，所以第二次潔面，我會揀溫和、易起泡，最好仲有少少去角質效果嘅潔面產品。呢款全部符合我嘅要求。我通常會將產品起泡，喺面上打一次，然後就沖走，唔會放喺皮膚上太耐。我好享受用呢款。

reviews.text: I have up on face wash and stuck to bar soap, then I felt like I should get one so I saw this in sukoshi. Used it, I loved it, it helps with my acne really well. Can’t say I recommend it cause everyone’s skin is different but I love it for myself
reviews.zh: 我之前已經放棄洗面奶，只用皂，之後覺得應該買一個，所以喺 sukoshi 見到呢款就買咗。用咗之後，我好鍾意，對我嘅痘痘好有幫助。我唔可以話推薦，因為每個人嘅皮膚都唔同，但我自己好鍾意。

reviews.text: The balmy/creamier texture of a cleanser actually worked for my oily skin! I was surprised because usually more gel-like or foam cleansers work better for me. It cleansed my skin well and didn't leave it feeling dry. I knocked off a star for the smell. It's supposed to be fragrance-free but there's a weird musky smell (probably from some of the ingredients) that I didn't like.
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面膏嘅質地比較濃稠、似奶霜，對我油性皮膚都好啱！我好驚訝，因為通常啫喱或者泡沫型潔面產品對我效果比較好。佢清潔得好好，洗完唔會覺得乾。不過我唔鍾意佢嘅氣味，明明話無香味，但有一股怪怪嘅麝香味（可能係某啲成分），我唔喜歡，所以因為氣味扣咗一粒星。

reviews.text:
I purchased several bottles because it's the only foaming cleanser that doesn't irritate my skin or make it feel dry after cleansing. My skin looks less red after just using this too. You don't have to have acne to use it. It has an extremely low percentage of salicylic acid and has many calming ingredients.

My sensitive and extremely redness prone skin approves. It's the only thing that has calmed my redness, combined with other PKY calming products.

Yes, I would repurchase this.
reviews.zh:
我買咗好幾支，因為佢係我用過唯一唔會刺激皮膚、潔完面唔會覺得乾嘅泡沫潔面產品。用完之後，我嘅皮膚睇落亦都冇咁紅。唔一定要有痘痘先可以用。佢含非常低比例嘅水楊酸，而且有好多舒緩成分。

我嘅敏感同極易泛紅嘅皮膚都接受呢款。佢係我用過唯一可以令我泛紅平靜下嚟嘅產品，配合 PKY 其他舒緩產品一齊用效果更好。

係，我會再買。

reviews.text:
-No scent at all
-Love the ”creamy” consistency, feels great on the skin
-Great for sensitive skin
-I have normal/combination skin and it didn’t leave my skin feeling stripped afterwards
-I can’t say if it alone makes a difference in my skin since I also use other new products, but my acne has gotten a lot better
reviews.zh:
- 完全冇香味
- 好鍾意佢「奶霜」般嘅質地，搽喺皮膚上好舒服
- 好適合敏感皮膚
- 我係正常／混合皮膚，用完唔會覺得皮膚被奪走水分
- 我唔敢講單靠呢款會有咩改變，因為我同時都用緊其他新產品，但我嘅痘痘好咗好多
